name: open-pr
description: Review GitHub Pull Requests and GitLab Merge Requests across many stacks, learning each repo's own conventions over time and posting one review via that vendor's own CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Review a PR or MR against the conventions learned from that repo.
interface.longDescription: Adds four skills: review a GitHub PR or GitLab MR and post one review, act on the findings a review left, migrate a repo's local config, and remove the worktrees review checked code out into. Posts through gh or glab, so the review appears as your own account.
defaultPrompt: Act on the open-pr findings left on https://github.com/org/repo/pull/123.
Remove the review worktrees open-pr left on disk.
